issues.message: CHK-001 userSees may be too abstract (does not contain specific output text in quotes). Should describe the exact text the user sees, not descriptions like "feature works correctly"
express channel allows fast path, but recommend adding at least one verificationIntent.happy for CHK-001 to help REVIEW/test-coverage reviewer align.

None of the checklist items have the files field filled in (legacy story compatibility mode); cannot perform coverage validation on understanding.touchpoints. Please list the changed files in files.modify/create/test for at least one item to enable strict touchpoint-to-files validation

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. `scope_check_save` already exists; a koala-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must persist the result through `scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not Authority Server completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full Authority completion.
